content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Jashpur Gram Panchayat Secretary at a Glance

rows.details: Higher Secondary (10+2) board examination passed and 1 year diploma in Data Entry Operator / Programming

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form in the prescribed format must be sent to the Office of Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Jashpur (Chhattisgarh), PIN code - 496331 by registered post or speed post only. Applications sent through any other medium, including private courier or email, will not be accepted. Candidates must clearly write the name of the post for which they are applying on the top of the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Minimum educational qualification is passing the Higher Secondary Board Examination (10+2) under a recognised board. One-year diploma in Data Entry Operator / Programming from an institution recognised by the government is mandatory. The candidate must be a local resident of Jashpur district, verified by a self-attested copy of a residence certificate issued by a competent authority. Minimum age: 18 years complete as of 01.01.2026. Maximum age: 35 years complete as of 01.01.2026. Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), and female candidates as per the instructions issued by the state government. Married female candidates who marry below the age of 18 years and males who marry below the age of 21 years are not eligible for appointment. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested passport-size photograph affixed on the application form and extra passport-size photographs. Self-attested copies of educational qualification mark sheets and certificates (High School, Higher Secondary, Graduation, Post Graduation). One-year diploma certificate in Data Entry Operator / Programming. Marriage certificate (optional) and age proof documents. Local resident certificate of Jashpur district issued by a competent authority. Caste certificate issued by a competent authority for reserved category candidates, along with a creamy layer certificate for OBC candidates where applicable. Valid live employment exchange registration card and number with date. Experience certificates countersigned by the Chief Executive Officer of the District Panchayat, showing clear dispatch numbers, dates, and designation, if claiming experience as Rojgar Sahayak. No Objection Certificate (NOC) through proper channel if working in government or semi-government institutions.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is based on a merit list prepared according to specific evaluation criteria and a computer skill test. Merit Determination: Marks are calculated based on 50 percent weightage of Higher Secondary marks, up to 10 marks for higher educational qualifications (5 marks for Graduation, 5 marks for Post Graduation), 25 percent weightage for marks obtained in the computer skill test, and up to 15 marks for experience working on the post of Rojgar Sahayak (3 marks per year, maximum 5 years, with a minimum of 09 months of service making a year). Computer Skill Test: Candidates called for the computer skill test will be in the ratio of 05 candidates against 01 post according to the provisional merit list. Ties in marks are resolved based on date of birth priority (older candidates getting preference). Probation: Selected candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 03 years, which may be extended up to 05 years if performance is found unsatisfactory.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 10 total vacancies notified for the Gram Panchayat Secretary post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 30 October 2026 up to 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary Board Examination (10+2) and possess a one-year diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as of 01.01.2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per state rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the offline application form and send it along with self-attested documents via registered post or speed post to the Office of Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Jashpur (Chhattisgarh), PIN - 496331.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on merit calculated from Higher Secondary marks, higher educational qualifications, computer skill test marks, and experience as Rojgar Sahayak, followed by a computer skill test.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is for the Gram Panchayat Secretary (Panchayat Karmi) post on a contract basis, with a 3-year probation period.

faq.question: Q9. Who is eligible to apply regarding residency?
faq.answer: Only local residents of Jashpur district are eligible to apply, supported by a valid residence certificate issued by a competent authority.
